concerns.text: The plan asserts that “All external dataset URLs are taken from the ‘Verified datasets’ block” (Principle II) but the document does not actually contain a ‘Verified datasets’ block listing those URLs. This makes the compliance claim unverifiable and violates Constitution Principle II.

The plan claims raw files are checksum‑verified (Principle III) yet no explicit step in the Phase mapping describes computing or recording checksums for downloaded data. Without a concrete checksum step the claim is unsupported, risking a breach of the Data Hygiene principle.
